en.headline: Two-month LPG fuel subsidy for taxis and minibuses ends tonight
en.dek: The temporary 50-cent-per-litre rebate for liquefied petroleum gas used by taxis, public light buses and school private light buses expires at 11.59 pm, after which drivers will pay full pump prices.
body: The Hong Kong Government's temporary liquefied petroleum gas fuel subsidy for taxis, public light buses and school private light buses will end at 11.59 pm on Thursday as scheduled.

Introduced on 31 May, the scheme provided a direct discount of HK$0.50 per litre of LPG at all 66 filling stations across the territory. It was intended to ease operating costs for about 16,900 LPG taxis, 3,440 public light buses and 170 school private light buses amid elevated fuel prices. Oil companies administered the rebate and the Government reimbursed them for the actual amounts paid out.

From Friday morning, drivers of eligible vehicles will pay the full retail prices set by oil companies. Taxi and minibus operators have previously warned that the end of the subsidy could raise monthly operating costs by as much as one-third in some cases and have called for an extension, citing continued volatility in international energy markets. The Inter-departmental Task Force on Monitoring Fuel Supply has said the measure was always intended as temporary and that auto-LPG prices have stabilised.

zh.headline: 的士小巴石油氣補貼今晚屆滿
zh.dek: 為期兩個月、每公升0.5元的臨時石油氣燃料補貼將於今晚11時59分結束，受惠車輛其後須按油公司牌價全數付款。
body: 政府為的士、公共小巴及學校私家小巴提供的臨時石油氣燃料補貼，將按原定計劃於星期四晚上11時59分結束。
補貼計劃於5月31日推出，在全港66個石油氣加氣站直接提供每公升0.5港元折扣，受惠車輛包括約16,900輛石油氣的士、3,440輛公共小巴及170輛學校私家小巴。油公司負責在加氣時即時扣減，政府其後向油公司發還實際補貼金額。
由星期五凌晨起，合資格車輛將須支付油公司釐定的全數零售價。的士及小巴業界早前警告，補貼結束後部分營運成本可能上升最多三分之一，並曾要求延長計劃，指國際能源市場仍然波動。跨部門監察燃油供應專責小組表示，措施原本就是臨時性質，而車用石油氣價格已趨穩定。
